scenario: unchanged exact range, same chapter revision
expected_invariant: accept only selected normalized Tiptap slice; one transaction

scenario: author edited target while AI was streaming
expected_invariant: revision or selection content hash mismatch; never replace new prose

scenario: author changed unrelated paragraph before response
expected_invariant: conservative CAS blocks; if step mapping used, remapped target and structural hash must match

scenario: author changed bold/italic marks in selection
expected_invariant: structural node+mark hash differs despite same plain text

scenario: author split target paragraph into two
expected_invariant: old numeric offset invalid; do not search-and-replace first text match

scenario: two proposals overlap same original selected text
expected_invariant: only first can apply; second must be revalidated
cancel is idempotent; ignore late completion
accepted chapter and canon byte/structural hashes unchanged

scenario: user accepts prose but rejects profile delta
expected_invariant: profile canon unchanged; independent review decisions

scenario: user clicks accept twice, or retry after timeout
expected_invariant: only one accepted revision/transaction; duplicate harmless

scenario: suggestion includes HTML/script or unsupported marks
expected_invariant: sanitize or reject invalid schema; no raw script injection

scenario: browser local undo after accepted server save
expected_invariant: editor undo must be saved as new authorized revision, not assumed durable rollback

scenario: rewrite would replace another book with same phrase
expected_invariant: scope includes authenticated author/book/chapter IDs not raw text matching

scenario: AI output is partial due 429 mid-stream
expected_invariant: partial output never auto-promoted; clear error/partial state

scenario: AI returns suggested change from unaccepted generated passage
expected_invariant: derived canon remains unapproved even if manuscript proposal accepted later
